phase_name: Close the validator blind spot in check-extension-docs.sh

objectives.description: Re-confirm premise: exactly 2 extensions (nix, nvim) declare hooks, zero declare verification, next letter is W
Add new rule function checking hooks.<stage> resolves and is in provides.scripts, for every extension
Validate stage names against the closed vocabulary
Advisory lane for not-deployed, fail lane for bad stage name / not in provides.scripts
Register in Rule letter index and dispatch loop
Run gate across all extensions, confirm no new advisories/failures for nix/nvim

verification_evidence.shellcheck_diff_vs_baseline: clean (content-only diff ignoring line-number shifts caused by the insertion)
verification_evidence.real_data_run: REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh (source-store invocation requires the REPO_ROOT override per deploy-root-guard.sh): [nix] and [nvim] sections show only the pre-existing, unrelated 'README.md older than manifest.json' WARN -- zero new ADVISORY or FAIL lines from Rule W. The 4 FAILs in the overall run are exactly this task's own 4 touched files' expected deployed-vs-source content drift (skill-base.sh, command-gate-out.sh, test-skill-base-lifecycle.sh, check-extension-docs.sh itself) -- all deliberately deferred to Phase 7/operator regeneration.
verification_evidence.negative_probe_bogus_stage: a throwaway fixture manifest with hooks.bogus_stage produces exactly 1 FAIL naming the bad stage; correcting the stage name to a valid one makes it clean
verification_evidence.negative_probe_not_in_provides_scripts: a hooks value whose basename is absent from provides.scripts produces exactly 1 FAIL; the fixture's sibling 'preflight' entry (basename present in provides.scripts, deployed, executable) produces zero findings in the same run, confirming no over-triggering
verification_evidence.negative_probe_not_deployed: a hooks value declared in provides.scripts but with no file under .claude/scripts/ produces exactly 1 ADVISORY (not a FAIL); creating the deployed file and re-running produces zero findings
verification_evidence.rule_letter_index_entry: W registered immediately after V, naming check_lifecycle_hooks_resolve and its lane split; dispatch-loop call added immediately after check_core_deploy_advisory
